_comment: MUTATION TESTING CONFIG. Stryker introduces small code mutations and runs the unit suite against each one; mutations the tests fail to catch ('survived') indicate weak assertions. First full run on the 10 services below is realistically 15-25 minutes on a 4-core machine — do not enable in CI. Run manually weekly or pre-release. See test/MUTATION.md for context. Mutate list is intentionally bounded to services that have colocated unit tests (apps/api/src/**/*.spec.ts); running on the entire codebase would take hours and most of it isn't unit-tested.
